brief: - API: cd {worktree} && pnpm nx run api:serve-local (reads that .env.local; http://127.0.0.1:{port}/docs). Database tests run in memory in the test process: nothing to start.

- Databases: serve-local uses the slot's own (ccms_{key}, made by setup-local). A throwaway database you make (a test's) you drop yourself; a perf benchmark run drops its profile's unless --keep; pnpm slot remove drops the slot's own.
